note: The American League's record against the National League in each regular season's interleague games, 1997 to 2017: [the American League's wins, the National League's] (docs/design/baseball.md, "One scale for both leagues"), from English Wikipedia's "Interleague play" at the revision `source` pins (its table of each season's total games and each league's wins; facts only). Each season's wins less losses are the Baseball Databank's American League clubs' wins less their losses (their games inside the league cancel out). Written by node scripts/sync-mlb-interleague.mjs; npm run build:mlb-seasons puts the two leagues on one scale with it (scripts/lib/mlb-war.mjs jointShareOf).
